title: Viral Marketing
source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 4 READING 본문 — Viral Marketing
body_text: Yuna: That’s the hottest dress on social media now. Lots of people are wearing it. I have to get that dress, too! Wait, Yuna! You only want the dress because you saw it again and again on social media. It isn't just you. There are a lot of people who fall for a viral marketing strategy. Why? Information about a product can spread quickly and widely on the Internet, just like a “virus.” If a product becomes hot on social media, people naturally want to have it. Yuna, just remember that a popular product isn't always right for you.
